# teams agent cleanup

Remove all Agent 365 resources for an agent (blueprint, instance, Azure)

## Usage

```
teams agent cleanup [name] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `name` | [OPTIONAL] Agent name; only needed if this folder has no a365 config file | No |

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output as JSON |
| `--dry-run` | [OPTIONAL] Show resources that would be deleted without making any changes |
